description: Requested vs quoted specification attributes: met, not met or not comparable — Compares up to 200 requested attribute requirements with the values a supplier quoted (voltage, grade, finish, tolerance, brand, certification), for an agent checking that a quote matches the request before buying. Requirements are eq, ne, gte, lte, gt, lt, between (value..max), in (a list) or present; numeric comparisons use exact decimals, an optional tolerance, and the caller's unit conversions

conversions.description: Caller-supplied unit conversions; none are built in.

factor.description: value in `to` = value in `from` x factor.

quoted.description: Omit or leave value out when the quote does not state the attribute.

tolerance.description: Absolute slack in the requested unit applied to numeric eq/gte/lte/gt/lt/between (e.g. a +/- 0.5 mm).

value.description: Required value (numeric ops need a decimal string).

name: qualifier-compare
